memories.content: A previous university management system proposal was successful when it clearly separated student, faculty, attendance, and administration modules.
A previous education-sector proposal was rejected because the implementation timeline was considered unrealistic.
A previous proposal for a system supporting more than 5,000 users emphasized scalability testing, database optimization, and load testing.
A previous proposal received positive feedback for providing a detailed security section covering RBAC, HTTPS, password security, and input validation.
